name: snippet
title: Snippet
description: An animated command snippet for React and shadcn, a one-line command with a copy button.

meta.details: A one-line command with a $ prompt and a copy button that morphs into a check. When the command changes (pnpm ↔ npm) the text swaps and the width springs, so the copy button glides instead of jumping.

docs: Import Snippet from components/eased/snippet/snippet. Pair it with useChoice("package-manager") from code-core and packageCommand from code-tabs to follow the reader's package manager.
